title: Durand v. Central Florida Presbytery
disposition_detail: This was a BCO 31-2 report affecting Christian character submitted directly to the SJC. The SJC ruled it administratively out of order and incapable of being put in order.
first_summary: The SJC held that a BCO 31-2 report affecting Christian character submitted directly to it was administratively out of order because no constitutional provision authorized direct receipt of such a report.
summary: The SJC considered whether it could receive directly a BCO 31-2 report affecting Christian character. It ruled the matter administratively out of order and incapable of being put in order because no constitutional provision authorizes such direct receipt. The order did not address the report’s substance or direct further proceedings.
